description: Autonomous AI agents built on ScholarClone's Fees Collection, NACH, Online Payment, Fee Circular, and Petty Cash sub-modules.

agents.name: Autonomous Fees Defaulter Detection & Escalating Reminder Agent
agents.problemStatement: School accounts staff manually identifies overdue fee accounts each month, then manually sends SMS/email reminders. With 500-2000+ students, this creates a 2-3 day workload each cycle, and late reminders result in cash flow issues. Fine calculation is inconsistent and dispute-prone.
agentRole: Scans all student fee records daily against due dates and payment status
Determines appropriate reminder channel and intensity based on days overdue and payment history
Triggers SMS/email/mobile notification without human intervention
Auto-calculates and applies late fine per Fees Late Master settings
Escalates to admin dashboard after 3 failed contact attempts

workflow.name: Nightly Batch Scan
workflow.description: Fees Monitoring Agent runs nightly batch scan across all student fee records. Cross-references due dates, payment received, and outstanding balance from Fees Status Report.

workflow.name: Account Classification
workflow.description: For Green accounts (< 7 days overdue): Agent sends gentle reminder via SMS/app push. For Orange accounts (7-30 days): Agent increases urgency, adds fine calculation per Fees Late Master, sends SMS + email to parent with outstanding amount and fine breakdown.

workflow.name: Critical Escalation
workflow.description: For Critical accounts (> 30 days): Agent flags for management dashboard, generates Fees Overall Report entry, and prepares draft communication for principal review.

workflow.name: Follow-up Tracking
workflow.description: Agent tracks response to each communication. If no response in 48 hours, escalates to next channel (SMS → Email → Phone call → Personal visit request).

outputs: Auto-applied fine entries in fee records

risks.risk: Incorrect overdue classification due to data sync delays
risks.mitigation: Implement 24-hour reconciliation buffer before nightly scan
Enable opt-out mechanism and compliance consent during admission

agents.name: Intelligent Fee Structure Recommendation & Auto-Circular Generation Agent
agents.problemStatement: At the start of each academic year, admin staff manually creates fee structures per standard/quota, generates fee circulars, and distributes them. This process takes 3-5 days and is error-prone, with wrong amounts sometimes sent to parents.
agentRole: Analyzes historical fee collection data, inflation indices, and pending balance patterns
Generates recommended fee break-off structures per standard/quota/admission year
Drafts fee circulars for each section/division using Fee Circular Master template
Queues them for admin one-click approval
Upon approval, autonomously distributes via SMS/email/mobile push to all parents segmented by standard

workflow.name: Historical Analysis
workflow.description: At academic year rollover, AI Agent reads last 3 years of Fees Break-off data and collection rates per standard.

workflow.name: Recommendation Generation
workflow.description: Recommendation Agent generates draft fee structure with percentage change suggestion per head (tuition, transport, hostel, etc.).

workflow.name: Admin Approval
workflow.description: Admin reviews and approves recommended structure with any modifications.

workflow.name: Circular Generation & Distribution
workflow.description: Circular Generation Agent uses Fee Circular Master templates to auto-populate amounts, bank details, due dates per standard/division. Upon admin approval, bulk distribution to parents.

risks.risk: Incorrect fee amounts distributed to parents
risks.mitigation: Mandatory 2-step approval: auto-generation → admin review → auto-distribution

agents.name: Predictive Fee Collection Forecasting & Cash Flow Intelligence Agent
agents.problemStatement: School management lacks early visibility into monthly/quarterly fee collection projections. Decisions about vendor payments, salary disbursals, and capital expenditures are made without cash flow data, leading to financial stress in low-collection months.
agentRole: Analyzes 3+ years of Fees Monthly Reports, payment patterns by standard/quota
Monitors NACH approval rates and seasonal trends
Posts weekly financial intelligence brief to management dashboard

workflow.name: Weekly Data Pull
workflow.description: Every Monday, Forecasting Agent pulls Fees Monthly Report, Fees Status Report, and NACH status data.

workflow.name: Pattern Analysis
workflow.description: Agent analyzes historical patterns: seasonal trends (fee collection dips in festival months), quota-wise collection rates, NACH success/failure patterns.

workflow.name: Forecast Generation
workflow.description: Generates 30/60/90-day collection forecast with confidence intervals per standard and fee head.

workflow.name: Risk Identification
workflow.description: Identifies cohorts at high default risk based on payment history, flags them for proactive intervention.

workflow.name: Brief Publication
workflow.description: Publishes weekly management brief with key metrics, forecast, and recommended actions.

risks.risk: Forecast inaccuracy due to unprecedented events (pandemics, natural disasters)
risks.mitigation: Include scenario planning with confidence intervals; flag low-confidence forecasts for human review

additionalUseCases.name: NACH Mandate Status Intelligence Agent
additionalUseCases.description: Monitor NACH auto-debit success rates, predict mandate failures, and proactively contact parents for re-submission.

additionalUseCases.name: Fee Payment Receipt Auto-Verification Agent
additionalUseCases.description: Automatically verify online payment receipts against bank statements, flag mismatches for reconciliation.

additionalUseCases.name: Fee Refund & Adjustment Intelligence Agent
additionalUseCases.description: Analyze refund requests, detect fraudulent adjustments, and ensure policy compliance.

additionalUseCases.name: Sibling Discount Optimization Agent
additionalUseCases.description: Automatically calculate and verify sibling discounts, identify families eligible for enhanced discounts.

phase1.name: Quick Wins
phase1.rationale: Delivers immediate ROI with minimal infrastructure. Uses existing data with no new integrations.

phase2.name: Core Intelligence
phase2.rationale: Builds predictive capabilities. Requires dashboard enhancements and LLM integration.

phase3.name: Advanced Automation
phase3.rationale: Complete automation. Requires bank API integration and policy engine.

complianceRequirements: DPDP Act 2023 consent for parent communication
Fee data access requires role-based access control
Student financial data encryption at rest
